 FREE AI CHECK Is your company ready for AI?
 Question 1 of 12 8 % 
 What industry are you in?
 Manufacturing & Production Services & Consulting E-Commerce & Retail Healthcare Logistics & Transport Finance & Insurance Other answer… 
 Sound familiar? Does this sound like your company?
 Most businesses we meet run on a patchwork of systems, spreadsheets, and manual handovers. Each card below is a piece of the same bigger problem.
 No single source of truth?
 CRM, ERP, field app, finance — each with its own version of the same customer. Your team copies data between systems all day.
 10,000 PDFs on your server?
 Data sheets, contracts, job cards — buried in folders, linked only by filename. Nobody finds anything fast.
 Excel running half the business?
 Job tracking, scheduling, coordination — all in fragile spreadsheets only one person can touch.
 Reports taking days instead of minutes?
 Pulling numbers from five systems by hand, formatting in Excel, hoping nothing's missing.
 Scheduling runs on whiteboards and WhatsApp?
 Teams, trucks, shifts, jobs — juggled manually across five browser tabs. One no-show re-plans the day.
 15 years of know-how in three people's heads?
 When they're out, nothing gets done right. When they leave, half the business walks with them.
 No data silos GDPR-compliant No vendor lock-in 
 Build your Company OS Unify your data into an intelligent hub.
 LAYER 01 · Single source of truth 
 Unified Data Model
 Every tool — CRM, ERP, field app, finance, messaging — flows into one normalized data model. Nothing duplicated, nothing re-entered by hand.
 Your Result One live view of your entire operation.
 LAYER 02 · End context-switching 
 Operational Surface
 The working surface your team lives in. Role-specific applications and pages built for how each function actually operates — sales, ops, finance, field. One login, every workflow, zero duplicate entry.
 Your Result Your team works in one place — across every function.
 LAYER 03 · AI that actually does the work 
 Intelligence
 Five tiers of AI on the unified data: search documents in seconds, answer questions in natural language, auto-generate reports, orchestrate workflows, deploy agents that run complete processes.
 Your Result Work that took hours, done in minutes.
 LAYER 04 · See everything. Control everything. 
 Control Plane
 Your Business Intelligence layer. Real-time KPI dashboards, cross-layer reports, and trend analysis — all built on your unified data. Plus full governance over every AI action: you approve, audit, and oversee. Nothing runs without your say.
 Your Result Total visibility. Full control.
